title: Mapping Community Meta-transcriptomics to gapseq-Annotated Metabolic Reactions and Transporters
author: Zhelun Zhang

steps.title: Trim raw reads
steps.instruction: Use trimmomatic PE to process reads with the following parameters: 12 threads, phred33, HEADCROP:33, SLIDINGWINDOW:4:20, and MINLEN:50.

steps.title: Remove rRNA
steps.instruction: Remove rRNA using sortmerna with the reference database CC_5_16_23s_rna_db.fa.

substeps.instruction: Run sortmerna with workdir ${sample_name}/P1_sortmerna and input ${sample_name}_paired_R1.fastq

steps.title: Build Bowtie2 index
steps.instruction: Prepare the reference genome for alignment by building a Bowtie2 index from the genome FASTA file.

steps.title: Align reads to genome
steps.instruction: Align paired reads to the genome using bowtie2 with 12 threads to generate a SAM file.

steps.title: Process alignment files
steps.instruction: Convert the SAM file to BAM format, sort it by genomic coordinates, and create an index file (.bai).

substeps.instruction: Convert SAM to BAM using samtools view -bS
Index sorted BAM using samtools index
Convert gapseq annotation to GTF using python GTF_generate_20230815.py with input ${genome}-Transporter.tbl
Count reads using htseq-count with parameters: -r pos, -t CDS, -m intersection-nonempty, --nonunique all, -f bam, using the sorted BAM and transporter GTF
Note: Allocate at least 60 GB memory; processing may take 3 hours per sample
Convert gapseq annotation to GTF using python GTF_generate_20230815.py with input ${genome}-all-Reactions.tbl
Count reads using htseq-count with parameters: -r pos, -t CDS, -m intersection-nonempty, --nonunique all, -f bam, using the sorted BAM and reaction GTF

steps.title: Sort transporter read counts
steps.instruction: Sort the transporter read count CSV file numerically by the second column in reverse order.

steps.title: Normalize and summarize reads
steps.instruction: Normalize and summarize metatranscriptomic reads mapped to each bacterial genome using Rscript summary_transporter_reaction_0911.R.

substeps.instruction: Provide three replicate sorted CSV files (a, b, and c)
Specify the genome and genome-Transporter.tbl file
Output the results to a .tsv file
